keySentence: Jim acted bravely despite great fear.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim's group hid in a fort. They needed water badly. Jim went out to help. Jim acted bravely despite great fear.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim and his friends took shelter in an old fort on the island. The pirates surrounded them and attacked again and again. Water was running low, and everyone was thirsty. Jim decided to sneak out in the dark to find water. Jim acted bravely despite great fear. His bravery for others showed his true character.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Inside the old wooden fort, Jim and his allies prepared to defend themselves. The pirates attacked repeatedly, and supplies began to run dangerously low. Without fresh water, they would not survive much longer in the tropical heat. Jim volunteered to sneak past the pirates under the cover of darkness. Jim acted bravely despite great fear. However, every step outside the fort meant risking his life. Because Jim cared more about his friends than his own safety, he moved silently through the night. His selfless bravery inspired everyone inside the fort to keep fighting.
